svg.title: KLACK storefront — E-Commerce Concept
svg.desc: An interactive mechanical keyboard storefront concept with layered motion, product storytelling and responsive design. Highlights: Layered, scroll-led motion, Product storytelling, Responsive on every screen. Built with HTML · CSS · JavaScript. Live demo at https://suhailchalil.github.io/klack/.

g.text: concept with layered motion, product storytelling
